items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: When I was with John A. Lee Long? That was in 1926.

ctx.x: That's right. In Cincinnati, well, they had the Roosevelt there. In Cincinnati, you'd get off at the station and walk, well, about a block to the theater, you know.

Is it right in that section? Yeah. That's all torn down, too. Yeah, I never saw it before. I found it out when we went back in there. What other shows, then, did you work with? How long? Well, what year was that? When I was with John A. Lee Long?
